⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

## Episode Thesis

Former Swedish finance minister Anders Borg calls US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's buybacks of long-dated Treasuries, and his yen intervention, 'nonsense'. He argues they shorten debt duration without cutting issuance, damage credibility and fail in highly liquid markets unless backed by fiscal and monetary tightening. He expects 10-year yields to keep rising worldwide because of large deficits, and warns that rate shocks would hurt equities. Even so, he is broadly positive on stocks because productivity is strong and inflation is low in both the US and China, and US companies are growing revenue 10-12% at 15-16% margins.
